transcript.content: Hello, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Hi. Nice to meet you too. 

Um, I'm here because I've been having this issue with my eating. After my cashier shifts, I just keep buying these huge takeout orders. I mean, it's like enough burgers, fries, chicken, and desserts for an entire family. And... I'll just sit there and eat almost all of it myself before I even go home. It's really getting out of hand, and I need to figure out how to stop.
After these eating episodes, do you ever make yourself vomit?

No, I don't do that. I've never made myself throw up. I just... I just sit with it, I guess. I feel really sick and stuffed afterwards, but I don't ever try to get rid of the food or anything like that.
After these eating episodes, do you do anything else to try to make up for them, like taking laxatives, fasting, or exercising a lot?

No, I don't do any of that either. I've never taken laxatives or anything like that. And I definitely don't exercise to work it off. 

Honestly, I usually just feel so heavy and tired after eating all that food... I just go home and go to sleep. I don't try to fast or skip meals the next day, either. I basically just feel terrible about it and move on until it happens again.
When these eating episodes happen, do you feel unable to stop eating or control how much you’re eating?

Yeah, that's exactly how it is. It's like... once I take that first bite, something in me just clicks off. I'll be sitting there, actually telling myself in my head, "Demetrius, stop, you don't need any more," but it doesn't matter. My hands just keep reaching for the next thing, and I just can't make myself stop until it's all gone.
How often do these eating episodes happen?

Well, for the last several months, it’s been happening three or four nights most weeks. It's... it's a lot. And honestly, I can’t remember a single week since the foreclosure calls started where I didn’t do it at least once.
